words.def: To acquire something is to gain possession of it.
words.ex: Tina acquired a strange package yesterday.

words.def: If something is awkward, it is embarrassing and uncomfortable.
words.ex: After dropping his coffee cup, Robbie felt awkward.

words.def: A caretaker is a person who takes care of very young, old, or sick people.
words.ex: My grandmother's caretaker helps her get around the house.

words.def: To deceive someone is to make them believe something that is not true.
words.ex: He tried to deceive his friends as they were playing a game.

words.def: To discourage someone is to make them feel less excited about something.
words.ex: Mr. Perry discouraged the students from quitting school.

words.def: If something is fake, it is made to look real in order to trick people.
words.ex: The model was wearing fake eyelashes.

words.def: Hatred is a strong feeling of not liking someone or something.
words.ex: I have a hatred for the taste of medicine.

words.def: A hut is a house made of wood, grass, or mud that has only one or two rooms.
words.ex: We all went into the hut to sleep.

words.def: If something is inferior, it is not as good as something else.
words.ex: Cars built a hundred years ago are inferior to ones built today.

words.def: A lodge is a house in the mountains, used by people who hunt or fish.
words.ex: During our ski trip, we stayed at a lodge.

words.def: To neglect someone or something is to not take care of it properly.
words.ex: William neglected his room, so it is a complete mess.

words.def: A newcomer is a person who has recently arrived at a place or a group.
words.ex: The students happily welcomed the newcomer to the school.

words.def: An offense is behavior that is wrong or breaks a law.
words.ex: Stealing a car is a very serious offense.

words.def: To overlook something is to not notice it, or to not realize that it is important.
words.ex: Brenda overlooked the last step and had a bad fall.

words.def: To repay is to pay back or to reward someone or something.
words.ex: She repaid her friend for all of his hard work with a small gift.

words.def: If something is ridiculous, it is silly or strange.
words.ex: Steve looked ridiculous with those huge blue sunglasses.

words.def: If something is satisfactory, it is good enough.
words.ex: Mina often received satisfactory grades since she studied so hard.

words.def: A shepherd is a person who protects and cares for sheep.
words.ex: The shepherd moved the sheep to another field.

words.def: To venture is to go to a place that may be dangerous.
words.ex: Even though it was dangerous, they ventured up the mountain.

words.def: Wheat is a plant which makes grain. Wheat grain is used to make bread.
words.ex: The field of golden wheat was ready to be harvested.

story.title: The Shepherd and the Wild Sheep
paragraphs: Once there was a shepherd. Every night he counted and gathered his sheep. He was sure never to overlook any of them. One night, he saw some wild sheep had joined his herd. He hoped to acquire the newcomers.

It snowed that night. In the morning, the shepherd couldn't take his sheep out of his lodge. Instead, he had to feed them inside. He gave a small amount of wheat to his own sheep. But he gave more of the food to the wild sheep. He thought the extra wheat would discourage them from leaving.
It snowed for several days. During that time, the shepherd's sheep ate very little. The wild sheep, however, ate very well.
At last, the snow melted, and they ventured outdoors. As soon as he opened the door of his hut, the wild sheep started to run away.
"Wait! This is how you repay me? After I treated you so kindly, why do you run away?" the shepherd asked. His voice was full of hatred.
The wild sheep stopped and turned toward the shepherd.

"We're leaving because you fed us better than your own sheep," one of the wild sheep replied. "You tried to deceive us with your ridiculous plan. Yesterday you treated us kindly, but tomorrow you might be different. If more wild sheep joined your herd, you would treat us as inferior sheep."

As the wild sheep ran away, the shepherd understood his offense. He knew this awkward situation was his own fault. He had not been a satisfactory caretaker. He was a fake friend to the wild sheep. Because of this, he had neglected his own herd.

word_list_exercises.title: Exercise 1: Part A. Choose the right word for the given definition.

questions.content: 1. a strong feeling of not liking someone or something
questions.explanation: Hatred means a strong feeling of dislike (sự căm ghét).

questions.content: 2. not as good as
questions.explanation: Inferior means not as good as something else (thấp kém hơn).

questions.content: 3. to get something
questions.explanation: To acquire is to get or gain possession of something (đạt được, giành được).

questions.content: 4. to go to a dangerous place
questions.explanation: To venture is to go to a place that may be dangerous (liều lĩnh đi vào).

questions.content: 5. a plant that makes grain
questions.explanation: Wheat is a plant used to make grain (lúa mì).

word_list_exercises.title: Exercise 1: Part B. Choose the right definition for the given word.

questions.content: 1. satisfactory
questions.explanation: Satisfactory means good enough (vừa ý, thỏa đáng).

questions.content: 2. newcomer
options: b. someone new to a place
questions.explanation: A newcomer is a person who has recently arrived (người mới đến).

questions.content: 3. repay
options: b. to not pay attention to
d. a bad thing that someone does
questions.explanation: To repay means to give back or reward (trả đền, báo đáp).

questions.content: 4. fake
questions.explanation: Fake means not real (giả mạo).

questions.content: 5. discouraged
questions.explanation: Discouraged means made to feel less excited or confident (bị làm nản lòng).

word_list_exercises.title: Exercise 2: Circle two words that are related in each group.

questions.explanation: Lodge và hut đều chỉ các loại nhà gỗ, lều nhỏ.
Shepherd và caretaker đều chỉ người chăm sóc, trông nom.
Fake (giả) và deceive (lừa dối) có ý nghĩa liên quan đến sự dối trá.
Awkward (kỳ cục) và ridiculous (nực cười) có nghĩa gần giống nhau.
Overlook (bỏ qua) và neglect (bỏ bê) đều liên quan đến sự thiếu chú ý.

word_list_exercises.title: Exercise 3: Choose the word that is the better fit for each blank.

questions.content: 1. The girl didn't like the ________, so she played a joke on them. She put ________ bugs in their drinks. (fake / newcomers)
questions.explanation: newcomers (người mới đến) và fake (giả mạo).

questions.content: 2. Dave hoped to ________ a new house. The ________ where he lived was too old. (acquire / lodge)
questions.explanation: acquire (sở hữu) và lodge (căn nhà gỗ).

questions.content: 3. She was eager to ________ the boy that had helped her repair her bike. While others had simply ________ her, he was happy to help. (repay / neglected)
questions.explanation: repay (đền đáp) và neglected (bỏ mặc).

questions.content: 4. Going to jail ________ the man from any ________ in the future. (offenses / discouraged)
questions.explanation: discouraged (làm nản lòng) và offenses (hành vi vi phạm).

questions.content: 5. In the middle of the storm, the ________ looked for his lost sheep by ________ up the mountain. (shepherd / venturing)
questions.explanation: shepherd (người chăn cừu) và venturing (đánh liều, đi đến nơi nguy hiểm).

questions.content: 6. My little brother tried to ________ us by dressing in Dad's clothes, but he just looked ________. (deceive / ridiculous)
questions.explanation: deceive (lừa phỉnh) và ridiculous (nực cười).

questions.content: 7. The farmer built his ________ close to the ________ field so he could constantly watch it. (wheat / hut)
questions.explanation: hut (túp lều) và wheat (lúa mì).

questions.content: 8. After the ________ started a small fire in the kitchen, he felt very ________. (awkward / caretaker)
questions.explanation: caretaker (người trông nom) và awkward (lúng túng, bối rối).

questions.content: 9. Most shoppers tend to ________ any products that they think are ________ to similar things. (overlook / inferior)
questions.explanation: overlook (bỏ qua) và inferior (kém chất lượng hơn).

questions.content: 10. She had a ________ for food with tomatoes, but everything else on the menu was ________. (hatred / satisfactory)
questions.explanation: hatred (sự căm ghét) và satisfactory (đủ tốt, thỏa đáng).

questions.content: 1. The shepherd counted his sheep because he didn't want to overlook any of them.
questions.explanation: Bài đọc viết: 'He was sure never to overlook any of them.' (Anh ta chắc chắn không bao giờ bỏ sót con nào).

questions.content: 2. The shepherd couldn't take the sheep outside because it was dark outside.
questions.explanation: Anh ta không mang cừu ra ngoài vì trời có tuyết ('It snowed that night...'), không phải vì trời tối.

questions.content: 3. The shepherd gave a little wheat to the wild sheep. But he gave his own sheep more.
questions.explanation: Người chăn cừu cho những con cừu hoang nhiều thức ăn hơn ('he gave more of the food to the wild sheep').

questions.content: 4. The wild sheep ran away from the shepherd after the snow melted.
questions.explanation: Bài đọc viết: 'At last, the snow melted... the wild sheep started to run away.' (Cuối cùng tuyết tan... lũ cừu hoang bắt đầu chạy đi).

questions.content: 5. The wild sheep thought the shepherd had neglected his own sheep.
questions.explanation: Những con cừu hoang nghĩ người chăn cừu sẽ đối xử tệ và bỏ bê chúng nếu có bầy khác tốt hơn, giống như cách anh ta bỏ bê bầy cừu hiện tại.

questions.content: 6. The shepherd never knew what he had done wrong.
questions.explanation: Cuối cùng anh ta đã nhận ra lỗi lầm của mình ('the shepherd understood his offense').

questions.content: 7. What was the shepherd's hope for the wild sheep?
options: a. That they wouldn't be awkward
b. That they would feel hatred for him
c. That he could acquire them
d. That he could repay them
questions.explanation: Anh ta hy vọng có thể thu nạp những con cừu mới ('He hoped to acquire the newcomers.').

questions.content: 8. How did the shepherd hope to discourage the wild sheep from running away?
options: a. By giving them extra food
b. By locking them in his hut
c. By selling his own sheep
questions.explanation: Anh ta cho chúng ăn nhiều hơn để chúng không bỏ đi ('He thought the extra wheat would discourage them from leaving.').

questions.content: 9. All of the following describe what kind of caretaker the shepherd was EXCEPT__
questions.explanation: Anh ta không phải là một người chăm sóc tốt (not satisfactory).

questions.content: 10. What was the shepherd's offense?
options: a. He never acquired the wild sheep.
b. He trapped the sheep in his lodge.
c. He hurt the wild sheep.
d. He did not care for his own sheep.
questions.explanation: Lỗi của anh ta là đã không chăm sóc tốt bầy cừu của chính mình ('Because of this, he had neglected his own herd.').
